recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, off-center close-up portrait of a man with a serious expression, set against a blurred urban night background with warm bokeh lights. The composition is anchored by a horizontal red line that transitions into a heartbeat-like waveform, supporting white script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the sharp, detailed facial features and the soft, out-of-focus city lights.
The horizontal red line acts as a structural divider between the subject's torso and the title text.
Warm skin tones and background highlights balanced by cool, dark shadows in the clothing and street.
coreInvariants: Tight cropping on the left side of the face.
A thin red horizontal line with a localized waveform spike.
Warm, circular bokeh in the upper right quadrant.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the left third of the frame, scaled to a large headshot that dominates the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes provide the primary emotional anchor, while the red line provides the structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, moves right to the top text, then down the right side to the bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the image serves as active negative space, filled with atmospheric bokeh and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones and deep shadows in the portrait and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the typography and the subject's inner shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the horizontal line and waveform graphic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text/shirt and the dark background; low saturation overall with a single high-saturation red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weight suggesting hand-drawn ink.
Slanted to the right for a sense of motion.
Connected lowercase letters with detached, expressive capitals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated and slightly jagged.
The 'V' in the title has a sharp, aggressive start.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over bokeh and dark street areas

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for both artist name and title to maintain stylistic unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the energetic, hand-drawn feel of the original.
Captures the raw, slightly jagged edges of the strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up, slightly low-angle portrait of a middle-aged man with brown hair and a serious gaze, wearing a dark textured jacket over a white t-shirt. The background is a dark, out-of-focus city street at night with warm, circular bokeh lights in the upper right. The lighting is cinematic with soft shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin, vibrant red horizontal line across the bottom third. In the center-right of the line, include a small EKG heartbeat spike. Place white hand-lettered brush script text in the top right and bottom right corners.

verificationChecks: Is the red line perfectly horizontal until the waveform spike?
Is the portrait sharp while the background is significantly blurred?
Does the script text look hand-drawn rather than digitally typed?

adjustableVariables: Color of the horizontal accent line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red line does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the white text is legible against the background.
Verify the bokeh shapes are soft and circular.
Confirm the portrait expression remains neutral/serious.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tight asymmetrical portrait + urban bokeh background + horizontal graphic divider + expressive script typography.
